subject: Temporary overnight 'canary' coverage — Kimball Health launch
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Kimball <jordan@kimballhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Temporary overnight 'canary' coverage request for launch (Nov 6-13)

Jordan —

Thanks again for walking through your launch timeline earlier. Kimball Health's go-live window (Nov 6–13) overlaps a regional campaign and we want to make sure support coverage is tuned for the expected spike. Per our call you asked whether Redwood can provide a temporary adjustment to response SLOs overnight (P1/P2) for the launch week and surface a clear escalation ladder.

Short summary of ask from your side:
- P1 response: 30 minutes target overnight (00:00–08:00 PT) for Nov 6–13
- P2 response: acknowledge within 4 hours overnight
- Formal escalation contact list with after-hours phone numbers
- A billing/credits mechanism if we miss the temporary window

I looped in Ben (Support Manager) and Karthik (SRE lead) to scope operational impact and cost. Attached is the runbook you shared in the call — I added the relevant pages as a reference.

Can Ben/Karthik confirm whether we can accommodate a short-term "canary coverage" carveout and what the trade-offs would be (fallback behavior, monitoring, cost)? If we can agree, I can draft a short MSA addendum and send to your legal team for signature.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call tomorrow (Nov 3) to confirm operational items and turnaround on the addendum. Are you available 8:30am or 11:00am PT?

Thanks —
Naomi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0137

Attachments: kimball_launch_runbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Jordan Kimball <jordan@kimballhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@kimballhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Temporary overnight 'canary' coverage request for launch (Nov 6-13)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear summary. Yes, those are the windows we discussed. A couple clarifications from our side:
- We are comfortable with a temporary exception, but need the P1 overnight target to be 30 minutes for the launch week to match our internal Ops runbooks.
- If the temporary SLO is not met for any P1 incident, we're asking for a small credit (pro-rated) for that day — nothing complex, just a way to ensure alignment.
- We need explicit escalation names and after-hours cell numbers for the 1st/2nd-level responders.

We can do the 11:00am PT call tomorrow. I'll have our product ops and legal reps on. I've attached our risk assessment and the snippet from our incident runbook that references expected vendor response times.

Jordan
Head of Product Ops | Kimball Health
jordan@kimballhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0920

Attachments: kimball_risk_assessment.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Temporary overnight 'canary' coverage request for launch (operational proposal)

Naomi / Karthik —

Read Jordan's ask. Operational / cost notes from Support:

What we can offer (30-day pilot window):
- Canary coverage window: Nov 6 00:00 PT — Nov 13 08:00 PT (weeknight and weekend nights)
- P1 overnight target: 45 minutes SLA (not 30) during the pilot; we will staff an augmented on-call schedule (one dedicated responder night shift + one roaming backup).
- P2 overnight target: acknowledge within 4 hours, full remediation SLA unchanged during daytime hours.
- Fallback: if an event escalates to Severity 1 (system-wide outage) we will immediately route to full 24/7 escalation and Redwood's standard P1 SLOs will apply.
- Credits: For any missed P1 overnight during the pilot we can offer a 0.5% daily credit on committed monthly usage for that day (capped).

Why not 30 minutes: our historical median overnight MTTI (mean time to initial) on existing canary shifts is ~38–50 minutes depending on concurrency. To guarantee 30m would require doubling the augmentation and a material temporary uplift in cost.

If Kimball is willing to accept 45 minutes for the pilot period we can stand this up with the on-call rota changes and an ops runbook. We should also record a short play-by-play Slack channel (read-only for your team) and enable an incident bridge template so your engineers can jump in immediately.

Next ops asks:
- Confirm acceptance of 45m pilot and credit terms
- Legal to sign a short addendum (I can draft)
- Confirm contact names and cell numbers for escalation ladder (see proposed list below)

Proposed escalation ladder (internal):
1) Night responder (primary): Sasha Li — +1 (415) 555-0104
2) Backup (secondary): Ben Carter (Support Manager) — +1 (415) 555-0110
3) SRE on-call (tertiary): Karthik Iyer — +1 (510) 555-0222
4) Account escalation: Naomi Feldman — +1 (415) 555-0137

I'll attach the Redwood on-call playbook v2 for your legal review and operations alignment.

Ben
Support Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_oncall_playbook_v2.pdf (pdf)

Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Temporary overnight 'canary' coverage request for launch (terms & next steps)

Jordan / team —

Thanks, Ben — that was a clear operational trade-off. Based on internal alignment, here's the proposed, short-term package to put in an addendum:

Agreement (Nov 6–13, 2026) — Kimball Health / Redwood Inference
- Coverage: "Canary" overnight coverage Nov 6 00:00 PT through Nov 13 08:00 PT.
- P1 overnight initial response target: 45 minutes (pilot).
- P2 overnight acknowledge: within 4 hours.
- Fallback: any incident classified as Severity 1 will immediately route to Redwood's full 24/7 P1 SLOs.
- Credits: For each calendar day during the pilot where an overnight P1 initial response exceeds 45 minutes, Redwood will credit 0.5% of Kimball's committed monthly usage for that day (capped at 3 days).
- Escalation contacts (Redwood):
   • Sasha Li (Night responder) — +1 (415) 555-0104
   • Ben Carter (Support Manager) — +1 (415) 555-0110
   • Karthik Iyer (SRE) — +1 (510) 555-0222
   • Naomi Feldman (Account Exec) — +1 (415) 555-0137

Next steps:
1) Jordan — confirm you accept the 45-minute pilot and credit terms so I can route a brief addendum to Legal.
2) Legal teams exchange the short addendum via DocuSign (I will initiate).
3) Ben/Karthik to stand up the canary rota and create the incident channel (read-only for Kimball).

Jordan — want to hop on the 11:00am PT call today to walk Legal through the single-page addendum before we send?

Best,
Naomi
